study_period.classification: EXPLORATORY; prior user approval covers this date range and explicitly permits PAPER P&L sweeps

strategy.individual_targets: entry level + direction * R; close the corresponding spot and futures legs only
strategy.fixed_basket_target: initial entry level + direction * R; close all active sets, then require a new entry crossing
strategy.stages: first threshold E; subsequent stages every 0.2 percentage point toward the observed extreme; no retroactive first-bar entries; one open set per stage

fills_and_time.fill: next continuous exact matched bar open only; cancel on missing minute, session break, or contract change
fills_and_time.roll: known expiry date at first regular continuous bar; close old contract and open next monthly contract using actual same-time 08:45 prices; no back-adjustment; Upbit spot remains open
fills_and_time.single_price_auctions: exclude regular 15:35-15:45 and night 05:50-06:00 from signal and order fills
fills_and_time.same_minute_labels: minute-boundary PAPER proxy, not verified simultaneous executable quotes
fills_and_time.price_gaps: never interpolate; retain position and revalue only at next observed quote

margin.historical_rates: Use effective-date KRX/official member margin notices; preserve source and rate type. Any dates without verified rates remain explicitly unverified and are not silently filled.
margin.delivery: roll each held futures leg on its listed final trading date before expiration; never simulate delivery as cash settlement

reverse_strategy_gate.historical_upbit_usdt_borrow_support: verify by date; USDT is not presumed borrowable for the full window
reverse_strategy_gate.cost_policy: no zero-cost assumption; reference results, if any, remain outside execution-qualified ranking
reverse_strategy_gate.integrated_switch_strategy: run only if borrow availability, collateral, terms, and costs are verified
